subject: Wrong size linen shirt from Lucheng store
body: Hi, I bought a linen shirt at the Wenzhou Lucheng store a few days ago, and when I got home I saw it's the wrong size. I checked the label against the hanger and it doesn't match what I asked for. I went back to the store once already but the person there told me they couldn't help me that day, so I'm writing instead. I still have the shirt unworn with the tags on and the receipt. Can you let me know what I can do about getting the right size? Thanks.
